links.outcome: Model discrimination (AUROC, AUPRC) on local retrospective data from a second hospital
links.effect: External hospital AUROC 0.875 (0.851-0.902), AUPRC 0.339 (0.281-0.398) vs 0.870 and 0.298 at the development hospital; performance consistent despite differences.
links.quote: PICTURE was able to identify general ward patients at risk of deterioration at both hospitals with consistent performance (AUROC and AUPRC) and compared favorably to existing metrics.

links.outcome: Comparison of PICTURE against Epic Deterioration Index and NEWS on the same data
links.effect: PICTURE outperformed both the Epic Deterioration Index and the National Early Warning Score at both institutions.
links.quote: PICTURE also outperformed both the Epic Deterioration Index and the National Early Warning Score at both institutions.

links.outcome: Comparison of development vs local populations, data and missingness, and effect on model performance
links.effect: Hospitals differed in missingness (>5% difference in 9/52 features), deterioration rate (4.5% vs 2.5%), and racial makeup (20% vs 49% non-White); performance remained consistent.
links.quote: The hospitals were found to have significant differences in missingness rates (> 5% difference in 9/52 features), deterioration rate (4.5% vs 2.5%), and racial makeup (20% non-White vs 49% non-White).

screen.reason: Empirical study testing external validation of an EHR deterioration model across two diverse health systems to assess transportability and performance under dataset shift.

primary.practice: external validation across diverse health systems
